import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": ["s0", "s1"]},
]
# entry with one direct pipe to keep a flag; state machine with unreachable s1 for filtered inputs
modules = [
  {"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"], ["n", "U8"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
   "requires": ["lt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "U8", 50]]},
  {"name": "f", "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
   "requires": ["ne", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", 0]]},
]
pipes = [{"target": "entry", "filter": "f", "bind": {"q": "n"}}]
machine = {"states": ["s0", "s1"], "initial": "s0", "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": [{"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "go", "cost": 1,
                            "when": ["lt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "U8", 10]]}]}
# harness: state x0 (w4), msg x1 buffer + x2 x3 chars, n x4 (w1), r x5 (w1), flag x6
def mk(state, msg, n, r, flag, drop=None):
    objs = [obj("x0", state, 4), obj("x2", ord(msg[0]) if msg else 0, 1),
            obj("x3", ord(msg[1]) if len(msg) > 1 else 0, 1),
            obj("x4", n, 1), obj("x5", r, 1), obj("x6", flag, 1)]
    if drop:
        objs = [o for o in objs if o[0] != drop]
    return {"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)}

doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes, "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": machine, "runs": []}

# n=5: filter accepts (n != 0), entry predicate true (5 < 50), guard true (5<10) -> s1 reachable
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 5, 0, 0)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"] == [{"status": "READY", "case": 0, "model_result": 0}], g["records"]
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["go", "hi"] and g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 1
print("PASS ready stateful")

# n=5 but transport broken -> INVALID beats everything
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 5, 0, 0, drop="x4")]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"] == [{"status": "INVALID_TEST"}] and g["corpus"] == [], g
print("PASS transport beats filter/reach")

# n=20: filter accepts, entry predicate true, guard false (20 >= 10) -> UNREACHABLE
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 20, 0, 0)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"] == [{"status": "UNREACHABLE"}] and g["corpus"] == [], g
print("PASS unreachable")

# n=60: entry predicate false (60 >= 50) and also unreachable -> FILTERED beats UNREACHABLE
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 60, 0, 0)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"] == [{"status": "FILTERED"}] and g["corpus"] == [], g
print("PASS filtered beats unreachable")

# n=0: filter rejects -> flag must be 1; entry predicate true; unreachable -> FILTERED
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 0, 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"] == [{"status": "FILTERED"}], g["records"]
print("PASS filter rejection beats unreachable")

# flag mismatch even though the entry predicate rejects the run
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 60, 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"] == [{"status": "INVALID_TEST"}], g["records"]
print("PASS flag mismatch beats entry predicate")

# corpus indices assigned by first usable run; invalid/filtered/unreachable never allocate
doc["runs"] = [mk(1, "hi", 60, 0, 0),      # FILTERED
               mk(1, "hi", 20, 0, 0),      # UNREACHABLE
               mk(1, "ab", 5, 0, 0),       # READY case 0
               mk(1, "hi", 5, 0, 0),       # READY case 1
               mk(1, "ab", 5, 7, 1)]       # DUPLICATE case 0 (flag 1 is a mismatch!) -> INVALID
g = run(doc)
# run 4: all filters accept (n=5 != 0) so flag must be 0, but it is 1 -> INVALID_TEST
assert [r["status"] for r in g["records"]] == ["FILTERED", "UNREACHABLE", "READY", "READY", "INVALID_TEST"], g["records"]
assert [c["witnesses"] for c in g["corpus"]] == [[2], [3]]
print("PASS corpus indices and witnesses")
PYEOF
